title: In an abstract ordered ring, the generic numeral builder distributes over addition
statement: For any ordered-ring record R and naturals m n, where ofNat R is the Nat.rec numeral builder over R's own add/one/zero (ofNat R 0 = zero, ofNat R (succ n) = add (ofNat R n) one), ofNat R (m+n) = add (ofNat R m) (ofNat R n).

formal.statement: theorem Alg.ofNat_add : ((x0 : Alg.OrderedRing) -> ((x1 : AxNat) -> ((x2 : AxNat) -> Eq.{1} (Alg.OrderedRing.carrier x0) (Alg.ofNat x0 (AxNat.add x1 x2)) (Alg.OrderedRing.add x0 (Alg.ofNat x0 x1) (Alg.ofNat x0 x2)))))

evidence.supports: Alg.ofNat (a Nat.rec Definition over R's own add/one/zero, the constant-motive-in-n shape Alg.npow already uses) and Alg.ofNat_add both admit through the trusted kernel gate. ofNat_add is proved by induction on n (the argument Nat.add recurses on): base needs only addZero (symm'd), the step needs a congruence on the IH plus one addAssoc application. Instantiated symbolically (closed over free m, n) at both Int.orderedRing and Rat.orderedRing.
evidence.checker_command: out=$(cargo test -p axeyum-lean-kernel --lib -- ofnat_add_symbolic_at_int_and_rat --nocapture --test-threads=1 2>&1) && test "$(printf "%s\n" "$out"| grep -cE 'test result: ok\. 1 passed; 0 failed')" -ge 1

evidence.supports: Alg.ofNat R 3 reduces (def_eq) to Int.ofNat 3 at R := Int.orderedRing, with a discriminating negative control against Int.ofNat 4 (a copy-paste numeral bug would pass an un-discriminating check).
evidence.checker_command: out=$(cargo test -p axeyum-lean-kernel --lib -- ofnat_evaluation_at_int_discriminates --nocapture --test-threads=1 2>&1) && test "$(printf "%s\n" "$out"| grep -cE 'test result: ok\. 1 passed; 0 failed')" -ge 1

notes: ADR-1584 section 5 named a generic numeral builder as blocker 2 to a linarith emitter over an arbitrary OrderedRing. Alg.ofNat and this law are that builder, used by linarith::generic (ADR-1585) to embed a nonnegative constant slack term without reaching for Nat.succ/a carrier's own literal representation.
